description: This file contains build definitions and instructions for creating filesystem images and device images for Netgear devices using the OpenWrt build system. It defines build steps such as creating root filesystem images with mkimage, squashfs images, and device-specific image configurations.

methods.name: Build/netgear-rootfs
methods.description: Defines the steps to create a root filesystem image for Netgear devices as a UBI or raw filesystem image.

methods.name: Build/netgear-squashfs
methods.description: Defines the process to create a squashfs image, compressing the filesystem for deployment to Netgear devices.

methods.name: Device/netgear_generic
methods.description: Configures the device-specific parameters and image generation pipeline for generic Netgear devices.
